Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the teams that build Zocdoc's provider platform — Provider Infrastructure and Provider Roster Management.

s.h: These teams create and scale the core systems that
s.t:
Store and serve provider, location, and roster data as a reliable source of truth.
Power onboarding and ongoing management experiences for practices of all sizes, from solo providers to large health systems.
Ensure provider changes propagate quickly and safely to downstream systems like Search, Availability, Analytics, and Integrations — so patients always see accurate information.
We're building towards a future where Zocdoc can onboard and manage tens of thousands of providers under a single organization in days, not months, with predictable performance and reliability across the stack. Your work will directly improve how quickly providers get live on Zocdoc, how confidently clients manage their rosters, and how reliably downstream experiences behave as we scale.
As a Senior Engineer here, you'll balance meaningful individual contribution with mentorship. You'll work across the stack — front to back and everything in between — with an emphasis on robust, observable services and high-scale data flows. You'll take ideas from inception to reality by rapidly iterating, validating with real usage, and hardening systems for long-term scale.

Excited by the challenge of scaling — passionate about building reliable systems with cloud-native infrastructure and event-driven patterns.
A product-driven engineer who enjoys partnering closely with PM, design, Ops, and analytics to solve real customer problems.
Motivated by building products that make healthcare easier for providers, operations teams, and patients.
Excited to use technology to simplify complex workflows — turning messy, high-volume data into clear, predictable experiences.

Building and evolving services and tools that power our scaling initiatives across Provider Infrastructure and Roster Management.

Note: As a Zocdoc engineer, you'll have access to and be encouraged to use generative AI coding tools as part of your day-to-day workflow.

At the Rehabilitation Engineering Laboratory (RELab) of ETH Zurich, we are developing ax|ReCover, a modular smartphone-based rehabilitation platform that aims to turn everyday smartphones into intelligent therapy devices for people with upper-limb impairments following neurological or traumatic injuries.

Our unique solution combines modular hardware, embedded electronics, physiological and biomechanical sensing, and mobile software to make rehabilitation more accessible, engaging and personalised. We are looking for a new team member who wants to develop products that directly improve people's lives.
In the context of an Innosuisse funded project, we are looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer with a strong electronics background to lead the development and improvement of the embedded sensing platform of ax|ReCover.

The funding for this specific position is limited to 16 months, and linked to specific work packages within that Innosuisse project.

Working closely with our research team, you will be responsible for the embedded firmware and electronics that power our modular rehabilitation system, with the objective of transforming research prototypes into a robust, manufacturable product.

This is a highly hands-on role spanning embedded software, electronics, sensors, prototyping and product development, in the field of neurorehabilitation technologies.

Join us as a (Senior) Backend Software Engineer (all genders) in our Vehicle Perception team and help shape the future of autonomous mobility!
To realise the vision of autonomous ride pooling, the Vehicle Integration domain develops the tools and applications that make passenger management possible without a driver. How can passengers authenticate themselves in the vehicle? How do we ensure a safe cabin during boarding and the ride? What content should be shown on the screens to create a safe and informative experience?
The Vehicle Perception team addresses some of these challenges by building end-to-end solutions for live video streaming, operator communication, and computer vision inside our vehicles. The team develops the technical foundation for real-time cabin awareness.

This includes live video pipelines that stream reliably from the vehicle to backend systems, as well as interfaces and services that enable operators to connect with passengers and provide timely support.

In addition, it implements perception models that are meant to detect and classify cabin states — for example, identifying occupied seats, forgotten objects, or compliance with safety requirements.
Our team has the necessary roles on board to take full responsibility for the given value streams: from backend and embedded developers to quality specialists, functional safety experts and product managers.

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential, and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
Every founder who applies for funding moves through one connected system, from the data that assesses their business in minutes, to the product experience that makes getting funded feel effortless. As a graduate engineer, you won't just be handed a slice of that system to maintain. You'll get exposure to the whole thing: the data model, the API, the screen a founder trusts with their business, and the room to figure out where you want to go deep.
What you'll actually do
Own features end-to-end: work with product and design to shape solutions, build them, and ship to production, creating outcomes, not just closing tickets
Write clean, testable code with comprehensive unit and integration tests
Build new features that drive revenue and engagement, while keeping the lights on for what's already live
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation
Push technical discussions forward and raise the bar on quality, rather than waiting to be told what "good" looks like
Every feature you ship has a real person behind it, a founder waiting on funding, a brand trying to grow, so the way you build matters as much as what you build.
What this role could turn into
Engineers who bring this kind of ownership tend not to stay in one lane for long. Some grow into technical leads shaping how we build across teams. Others move into product-adjacent roles, working even closer with the businesses we serve. And some end up specialising deep into the systems and infrastructure that let us scale globally. Where you go depends on what you're curious about.
Who thrives here
You're a curious builder who gets genuine satisfaction from turning a messy idea into something people actually use. You ask questions before you assume, communicate clearly when something's not working, and take ownership without needing permission for every step. You're comfortable in ambiguity, you'd rather experiment and learn than wait for the perfect brief, and how you treat people matters to you as much as the code you ship.
We hire for range
A computer science background (or equivalent hands-on experience), with a solid grip on data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals
Comfort with Git and modern development workflows
Hands-on experience with Python, React (or similar), and SQL/relational databases
Bonus, not required: exposure to REST APIs, testing frameworks, CI/CD, cloud, or containerisation
We're less interested in ticking boxes on a CV and more interested in trajectory.
Location and working policy
Based in our Dublin HQ. Hybrid, 3-4 days onsite to start, transitioning to a more flexible remote role over time.
The good stuff
25 days annual leave plus public holidays, private healthcare, life insurance and critical illness cover, a pension plan, generous parental leave, equity, and the option to work from abroad for up to 60 days a year.

The UI Foundation team owns the frontend infrastructure that every product engineer at Amplitude builds on — architecture, performance, developer experience, tooling, and build systems. We're the team that makes shipping fast, reliable frontend code possible at scale, and we're increasingly focused on how AI agents can autonomously handle engineering workflows that used to require constant human intervention.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who thinks like an infrastructure engineer but has deep fluency in frontend systems. You'll drive architectural decisions for our frontend platform, push performance and DevX forward, and lead the build-out of our "software factory" — a set of autonomous, AI-agent-driven engineering workflows that increase engineering velocity across the org.
This is a high-leverage, low-oversight role. You'll be setting technical direction for a foundational team, not just executing a roadmap someone else wrote.

Frontend architecture: Own and evolve the architectural foundations of our frontend platform — module boundaries, micro-frontend patterns, shared component/design-system infrastructure, and state management strategy.
Application performance: Diagnose and fix systemic performance issues (bundle size, load time, runtime performance, rendering bottlenecks); establish performance budgets and guardrails that scale across teams.
Developer experience & tooling: Build and maintain the build systems, local dev environments, CI/CD pipelines, linting/codegen, and internal tooling that other engineers depend on daily.
Software factory / agentic workflows: Continuously identify the biggest bottleneck in the engineering workflow and build AI-agent-driven automation to remove it, then move to the next one. For example, once code and PR generation stopped being the constraint, the bottleneck shifted to validation — and that's the next thing to automate. This is an ongoing, iterative practice of finding where engineers are spending unnecessary manual effort and systematically eliminating it with agentic tooling.
Technical leadership: Set technical direction and standards for the frontend org; mentor senior/staff-track engineers; review architecture proposals from other teams that touch shared frontend infrastructure.
Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with product engineering teams, design systems, and platform/infra teams to make sure foundational investments actually solve real product-team pain points.

Join ACAI (Advanced Calendar Improvement) , a team dedicated to making day-to-day practice operations more efficient and less mentally exhausting for healthcare professionals and their teams.
Practice operations are often fragmented across post-its, emails, SMS, phone calls, oral instructions, and individual memory. This makes it difficult for teams to know what needs to be done, who owns it, how urgent it is, and what has already happened.
As a Software Engineer, you will help build products that centralise work, improve coordination, and automate administrative tasks across the practice; directly contributing to a smoother experience for healthcare professionals, staff, and patients.

Develop reliable, intuitive features for Task Manager, Patient Flow Management, patient intake, appointment proposals, and telesecretaryship workflows
Help practices coordinate the patient journey from arrival to completion of a visit, including waiting-room status, care steps, walk-ins, delays, patient movement, and check-out
Design solutions that reduce the time healthcare professionals and staff spend manually creating, sorting, remembering, relaunching, and completing tasks
Work across backend and frontend technologies to deliver high-quality, user-facing experiences
Build performant, reliable, and observable services that can support Doctolib's growing user base and complex healthcare workflows
Apply strong privacy, data protection, and security practices when working with personal and health-related information
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Protection, and other engineering teams to understand problems and deliver valuable solutions
About our tech environment
Our solutions run on a single, fully cloud-native platform serving web and mobile applications across multiple languages and countries, each with its own regulatory and specialty-specific requirements.
To address these challenges, we are modularising our platform through reusable components and a distributed architecture.
On ACAI, you'll primarily work with Ruby and Kotlin on the backend and React with TypeScript and Rails on the frontend. Doctolib's broader technology environment also includes Java, Python and Swift.
We leverage AI in an ethical manner across our products to empower patients and healthcare professionals. Discover our AI vision .

You use AI tooling thoughtfully as part of your engineering workflow
You enjoy sharing knowledge, contributing to team discussions, and helping others grow
You demonstrate a growth mindset and a strong learning agility
You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a collaborative, discussion-oriented environment

From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale.
Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta’s growth.
Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

The Integrations Platform team mission is to power the world’s largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly.

We own Vanta’s integration ecosystem, which currently includes over 400 integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information System (HRIS). We are focused on developing the Integration Platform.

This includes creating shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing to ensure all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely.

We aim to enable anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI Agents.

s.h: What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta
s.t:
Set technical strategy and direction for critical platform surface areas, staying ahead of rapid growth.
Design and evolve the APIs, primitives, and self-service golden paths that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.
Own the authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution primitives that keep integrations with external systems secure and reliable at scale.
Build secure, well-documented, scalable backend services and developer tooling (including CI/CD) that propel engineering productivity.
Drive performance, operational excellence, and SDLC best practices; make and defend buy-vs-build and one-way-door decisions.
Act as a force multiplier: mentor and uplevel teammates, and set the design patterns the team standardizes on.
Build with TypeScript, React, and Node.js, and use AI tools to accelerate development and workflows.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
8+ years of backend development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.
Platform and API design: you've evolved core APIs, SDKs, and platform abstractions, with deep expertise in RESTful APIs, GraphQL, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.
Data Integrations: you've built resilient data ingestion from external systems, including integrations with cloud providers, HRIS platforms, identity providers, and code repositories. You champion best practices such as rate limiting, retries and idempotency, webhooks, and handling schema drift.
Systems thinking at scale: you design for scale, reliability and failure modes. You look around corners and proactively identify and address risk.
Technical leadership and cross-team influence: you've led teams and complex projects, and influenced decisions across the organization.
Internal Enablement and Evangelism: you build sample integrations, POCs, AI Skills, documentation, and workshops to help internal engineering teams onboard quickly to the platform.
Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, greenfield work, multi-region or Gov deployments, and prior experience in security or compliance products.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

With more than 10 billion pulls , Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images.
We are advancing the state of the art with a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.
This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. Automation is central to the role: you will build the pipelines that package, build, test, and publish images at scale.
Your seniority in this role will reflect your software engineering experience and your ability to mentor and guide more junior colleagues.

Build and maintain a growing portfolio of high-quality, hardened container images
Design and operate automated CI/CD pipelines that build, test, scan, sign, publish, promote, and retire images across environments and architectures
Write tooling and tests to assess security compliance and cloud-native compatibility
Work closely with the community and partners to share container expertise and keep our portfolio current with new features, patches, and applications
Collaborate with our product security, platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams

Informatiker:in ist ein umfassender Beruf, der viele Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet. bbv Software Services bietet dir den idealen Start in deine Berufskarriere.
Informatiker:innen mit Schwerpunkt Applikationsentwicklung sind Fachleute in der Entwicklung von Software. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Planung, Programmierung, das Testen, die Dokumentation und Präsentation von Anwendungen. Dabei lernst du, Informatikprojekte selbstständig umzusetzen \- von der Idee bis hin zur Einführung.

Du begleitest Projekte und erarbeitest Lösungen für individuelle Applikationen. Das kann beispielsweise die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen betreffen, das Erstellen von Websites oder die Programmierung einer mobilen Applikation.
Deine Aufgaben
Deine Ausbildung setzt sich aus einem theoretischen und einem praktischen Teil zusammen und dauert vier Jahre. Bei uns kannst du direkt vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung übernehmen:
Die praktische Ausbildung findet an unserem Standort Luzern in den Bereichen Applikationsentwicklung mit Fokus auf .NET\-Technologien sowie Software\-Qualitätssicherung (Testen von Software) statt
Im Rahmen des ICT\-Informatik\-Basislehrjahrs verbringst du das erste und vierte Semester bei der ICT Berufsbildung Zentralschweiz in Kriens
Die theoretische Ausbildung umfasst den Besuch der Berufsschule (zwei Tage pro Woche) und von überbetrieblichen Kursen
Dein Profil
Du hast gute schulische Leistungen in Sekundarstufe Niveau A oder sehr gute Leistungen in Sekundarstufe Niveau B
Du verfügst über sehr gute Schulnoten in Mathematik, Deutsch und Englisch
Technik und Informatik begeistern dich
Du verfügst über eine exakte Denk\- und Arbeitsweise sowie eine rasche Auffassungsgabe
Du hast Freude an komplexen Aufgaben und bist eine aufgeweckte und motivierte Persönlichkeit

Basés sur des connaissances scientifiques, nous développons des solutions individuelles et globales auxquelles nos clients peuvent faire confiance tout au long du cycle de vie. Avec une humidité optimale, nous augmentons la productivité et créons un climat intérieur plus sain.

Le groupe Condair dispose de sites de production en Europe, en Amérique du Nord et en Chine, ainsi que de ses propres organisations de vente et de service dans 23 pays et de représentations dans 50 sites à travers le monde.

* **Développement logiciel :** Développement de solutions innovantes et efficaces pour nos projets logiciels embarqués exigeants dans un environnement agile

* **Sécurité & conformité :** Mise en œuvre de notre processus de développement logiciel sécurisé pour garantir un logiciel sûr en respectant les normes pertinentes (par ex. IEC 62443 et le nouveau règlement CRA)
* **Collaboration :** Collaboration étroite au sein d'une équipe internationale et interdisciplinaire composée d'experts en électronique, mécanique et gestion de produit

* **Formation :** Formation technique achevée (FH, université, ETH, HF) en informatique, génie électrique ou technique des systèmes
* **Expérience :** Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique dans le développement logiciel pour systèmes embarqués temps réel ainsi que dans l'implémentation de protocoles de communication
* **Stack technologique :** Très bonnes connaissances en C/C++ ainsi qu'une pratique solide en C\# et Python
* **Bus de terrain & IoT :** Expérience avec des protocoles réseau industriels (BACnet, Modbus, CAN/CANopen ou MQTT) un atout
* **État d'esprit :** Plaisir à analyser des problèmes complexes et conscience aiguë de la qualité pour l'optimisation continue de nos solutions
* **Méthode de travail :** Tu travailles de manière autonome, structurée et es un véritable joueur d'équipe
* **Langues :** Bonnes connaissances en allemand et en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit

**Über cyon**
cyon ist ein mit über 20 Jahren erfahrener unabhängiger Schweizer Webhosting-Anbieter mit Sitz in Basel. Rund 50-000 Kund:innen vertrauen auf cyon - wegen persönlichem Support, einfacher Verwaltung und nachhaltigem Hosting. Wir verbinden technische Kompetenz mit Nähe und Herzlichkeit.
Unsere Software ist über viele Jahre gewachsen - und wir gestalten gerade aktiv ihre Zukunft. Für diesen Weg suchen wir eine erfahrene, technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die sowohl unsere bestehenden Systeme sicher weiterentwickelt als auch Innovationen vorantreibt. Kurz: jemanden, der cyon auf der Software-Seite noch besser für die Zukunft aufstellt.
**Deine Aufgaben**
* Bei uns übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung anspruchsvoller Softwarelösungen und neuer Features - von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
* Dabei stellst du sicher, dass funktionale und technische Anforderungen erfüllt sind und unsere Lösungen hinsichtlich Performance, Qualität und Sicherheit überzeugen.
* Du begleitest den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und sorgst mit sauberem Code, aussagekräftigen Tests und einer klaren Dokumentation für nachhaltige Stabilität.
* Unsere Systeme sind über viele Jahre gewachsen. Du kümmerst dich auch um Wartung und gezieltes Refactoring unserer bestehenden Lösungen, sorgst dafür, dass diese zuverlässig und zukunftsfähig bleiben, und treibst mit dem Team deren schrittweise Modernisierung voran.
* Mit modernen Entwicklungs- und Architekturansätzen sowie den passenden Tools bringst du Struktur, Transparenz und Effizienz in unsere Softwareprojekte.
* Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge produktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag ein und hilfst, sie sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in unsere Arbeitsweise zu integrieren.
* Du entwickelst KI-basierte Funktionen (ML- und LLM-Features) für unsere Produkte und Prozesse - mit Blick auf echten Nutzen für unsere Kundschaft, Zuverlässigkeit und Datenschutz.
* Du bearbeitest spannende Incidents und unterstützt so unsere Kundschaft und den internen Support bei technischen Problemen.
**Das bringst du mit**
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung FH, Uni in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung in der PHP-Entwicklung, idealerweise auch mit Laravel und PHP 8.x
* Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken (MySQL, PostgreSQL) und komplexen SQL-Abfragen
* Praktische Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von RESTful APIs sowie Integration von Drittanbieter-APIs und externen Services
* Professionelle Kenntnisse in JavaScript, HTML5 und CSS3 sowie Verständnis für moderne Frontend-Paradigmen und die Bereitschaft, diese künftig einzusetzen
* Bereitschaft und Erfahrung, an bestehenden Legacy-Systemen mitzuentwickeln und diese schrittweise zu modernisieren
* Erfahrung und Verständnis für Infrastructure as Code und DevOps-Prinzipien

Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.
We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.
We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.
AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.
Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.
This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

Own features end-to-end across Sona's platform, from scoping through to delivery, including in the mobile app
Use AI development tooling as your primary workflow - directing and evaluating agent-produced code, not writing everything from scratch
Work directly with customers through workshops, feedback sessions, and discovery conversations to ensure what you build solves real problems
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Product Designers to shape solutions from vague requirements and kick-off outputs
Contribute to multiple product domains across the year, building deep understanding of workforce management challenges
Participate in the product development process - challenging scope, suggesting approaches, and making pragmatic trade-offs between the ideal solution and the right one for now

You're a senior engineer who's comfortable owning features from scoping to production - not just executing against a spec
You have professional Elixir experience - enough to evaluate and correct agent-produced code in a production codebase
AI development tooling is already embedded in how you work, not something you've experimented with once or twice. You can articulate your workflows and demonstrate them under pressure
You care about understanding customer problems as much as solving technical ones, and you're comfortable being in front of customers directly
You communicate clearly and concisely - adapting for technical and non-technical audiences alike
You're pragmatic: you can let go of a strongly held opinion when the situation calls for it, and you make trade-offs consciously
Bonus: full-stack experience including React Native, background at a product-led engineering team or high-growth B2B SaaS company, or familiarity with HR/workforce management domains

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you'll own the complete software development lifecycle from solution design and implementation through testing, production deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. AI-driven development is a core part of how we build software.

Share effective AI-assisted engineering techniques and best practices across the team.

Work closely with Product, Design, Platform, CloudOps and other engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

Buscamos un desarrollador Full Stack semi senior o Junior avanzado con experiencia comprobable en Python y Django, capaz de trabajar tanto en aplicaciones construidas con Django Templates como en servicios backend y APIs desarrolladas con Django REST Framework.
Es fundamental que pueda trabajar con Azure SQL Database y T-SQL, incluyendo la creación, mantención y optimización de consultas y procedimientos almacenados.
En frontend, deberá contar con experiencia en JavaScript, TypeScript y React. Se valorará el conocimiento de Next.js, renderizado SSR, Tailwind CSS y librerías de componentes, ya que deberá mantener interfaces existentes y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para distintas plataformas web.
También se valorará la experiencia en integración de APIs REST, autenticación mediante tokens o sesiones, procesamiento asíncrono de tareas y servicios de Azure como App Service, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Redis.
Necesitamos una persona metódica y responsable, capaz de analizar código existente, diagnosticar problemas y proponer soluciones que no afecten la continuidad operativa de los sistemas. Deberá organizar su trabajo con autonomía, comunicar oportunamente los avances y dificultades, documentar sus desarrollos y cumplir los plazos acordados.
Como trabajará junto a profesionales de distintas áreas, deberá ser capaz de comprender requerimientos funcionales y técnicos, formular preguntas cuando existan ambigüedades y transformar las necesidades de cada proyecto en soluciones web claras, seguras y mantenibles. Valoramos especialmente la disposición para aprender, colaborar, recibir retroalimentación y asumir progresivamente mayores responsabilidades.
Formarás parte del equipo de desarrollo de Weyland, colaborando con profesionales de automatización, inteligencia artificial, electrónica y gestión de proyectos. Tu trabajo estará orientado a mantener y evolucionar las plataformas web que respaldan nuestras soluciones de automatización de procesos de negocio y monitoreo de variables industriales y ambientales.
Inicialmente, trabajarás en los sistemas actuales, y posteriormente comenzarás a diseñar e implementar nuevos sistemas. Tus principales funciones serán:
Analizar y corregir incidencias en las plataformas existentes.
Implementar mejoras y nuevas funcionalidades en frontend y backend.
Desarrollar módulos, interfaces, APIs e integraciones con bases de datos y servicios externos.
Crear y optimizar consultas y procedimientos almacenados.
Integrar información proveniente de múltiples bases de datos y fuentes de datos.
Realizar pruebas, documentación técnica y revisión de código.
Apoyar el despliegue, monitoreo y mantenimiento de las aplicaciones en Azure.
Diseñar modelos de datos eficientes y robustos.
Diseñar sistemas web que resuelvan las necesidades del proyecto, basado en las arquitecturas, frameworks y tecnologías que son parte de nuestro stack tecnológico. Las propuestas de mejora son siempre bienvenidas, serán evaluadas y consideradas,
Velar por la seguridad, estabilidad, rendimiento y continuidad operativa de los sistemas.
A medida que conozcas las plataformas y procesos de la empresa, asumirás la responsabilidad de desarrollar nuevos módulos y sistemas web para futuros proyectos, participando desde el levantamiento de requerimientos hasta su implementación y puesta en producción.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.
Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.
Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.
Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity
Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Denmark, however there is a preference for candidates to be based out of Copenhagen. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Danish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
Our Software Engineers build and own high-value products for our customers and the infrastructure that lets our business scale.
Vanta's team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it's essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to scale with our business. As a Software Engineer, you'll build and own full-stack features and platform primitives across our stack, work closely with the teams and partners who depend on what you ship, and grow into broader technical ownership. Your work will directly accelerate Vanta's growth.
Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.
Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!
The Integrations Platform team mission is to power the world's largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly.

We own Vanta's integration ecosystem, which currently includes over 400 integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information System (HRIS). We are focused on developing the Integration Platform.

This includes creating shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing to ensure all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely.

We aim to enable anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI Agents.
What you’ll do as a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Integrations Platform at Vanta:
Design, build, and own full-stack features and platform primitives that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.
Contribute to our authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution services, keeping integrations with external systems secure and reliable.
Build secure, well-documented, scalable services and UI with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
Improve performance, operational excellence, and SDLC practices within the team.
Use AI tools and workflows to accelerate development and operations.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
6+ years of full-stack development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.
Platform and API design: you've built APIs and reusable components others depend on, with solid grounding in RESTful APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.

AI Engineering and Delivery is the customer-obsessed engineering group building the agentic AI and enterprise-scale search systems that power Now Assist, AI Agents, and the AI-driven experiences our customers rely on every day. We build AI as foundational platform infrastructure — prioritizing robustness, performance, safety, and real-world customer impact at scale.
Types of problems you’ll get to work on
You will design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems embedded across ServiceNow's platform — autonomous agents that reason over real enterprise data, take action across workflows, and run safely at Fortune 500 scale.

Agentic architecture . Design and ship multi-agent systems — orchestration, tool use, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery — that operate reliably in production, not in notebooks.
Enterprise-grounded reasoning . Build agents that leverage ServiceNow's data layer — CMDB, Workflow Data Fabric, and Knowledge Graph — to make decisions with context no frontier model has on its own.
Trust, safety, and governance . Own the guardrails: observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and compliance infrastructure that make autonomous systems safe to deploy at scale.
Retrieval and grounding. Work closely with our search team to ensure agents are grounded in accurate, low-latency retrieval — RAG pipelines, hybrid search, re-ranking, and evaluation — as a critical dependency of agentic quality.
Model integration and evaluation. Integrate frontier models (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI) into the Sense → Decide → Act → Govern architecture; evaluate trade-offs across cost, latency, and capability for production use cases.
Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and coaching — particularly on agentic design patterns and production AI discipline.

s.t:
8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Hands-on depth designing, shipping, and operating agentic systems in production — multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery. Not prototypes.
Production-grade Python. Systems language (Go, Java, or C++) is a plus.
Working experience with frontier AI SDKs (Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI) — prompt engineering, structured outputs, and model evaluation in production settings.
Familiarity with RAG and retrieval patterns in production — vector stores, hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation metrics.
Track record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers on production AI practices.

Deeper specialization in search and retrieval at scale or MLOps/model observability.
Published work or open-source contributions in agentic systems or retrieval.
Exposure to LLM fine-tuning or inference optimization in production.

Intelligence is commoditizing. Context and execution are not. With 100B+ workflows, 6.5T transactions a year, and 85% of the Fortune 500 on our platform, we are building the system that makes AI actually work inside the enterprise — Sense, Decide, Act, Govern.
What's shipping as we speak: AI Specialists autonomously resolving cases across IT, CRM, HR, and Security. Action Fabric opening our full system of action to any external agent via MCP — Anthropic's Claude Cowork is the first design partner. Project Arc with NVIDIA bringing governed autonomous desktop agents into production.

Build Agent live inside Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. AI Control Tower with kill-switch capabilities and cross-vendor agent governance. These are production systems at Fortune 500 scale, not roadmap slides.
You'd work across three problem spaces at the frontier of what we do:
Autonomous Enterprise: Self-driving business processes grounded in CMDB, Workflow Data Fabric, and Knowledge Graph — context no frontier lab can replicate,
Omni-channel AI Resolution: Production voice, chat, and computer-use agents with generative UI, live with customers today,
AI Control Tower: Identity, entitlements, and audit-grade compliance for every agentic system in the enterprise — nobody else has this layer.
You will build the substrate that connects all four: SENSE (any data) → DECIDE (any AI model) → ACT (any workflow) → GOVERN (identity + governance). The architectural inflection point is now.

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch Performance team.
